question: problem1
title: Exact worst-case precision loss in the period-two first-return map

exact_results.gap_conditioned_upper_bound: a gap-r return determines k successor bits from k+2r source-coordinate bits
exact_results.worst_case_theorem: for every k>=4, (rho(z),R(z) mod 2^k) is determined by z mod 2^(k+10), and 2^(k+9) never suffices
exact_results.iterated_budget: along gaps r_0,...,r_(J-1), k final bits are determined by k+2*sum(r_i) initial bits

research_consequence: No deterministic fixed-width suffix quotient can propagate the full first-return coordinate. Continuation must retain growing high-front information or a special global invariant of the zero-initialized orbit.
scientific_boundary: This result does not determine the unique actual higher-bit orbit, prove permanent avoidance of the consecutive-gap-two cylinders, exclude eventual center period two, or solve Rule 30 center nonperiodicity.
